text:
maria: Heads-up — we're kicking off the migration of release pipelines to a centralized releases-bot + GitHub Actions hosted runner pool. Goal is to retire per-repo Buildkite jobs for production releases and reduce flakiness.

maria: TL;DR plan:
- Week 1: opt-in pilot for 5 services (canary group)
- Week 2: enable auto-gating via releases-bot for all repos in org/release-managed
- Week 3: deprecate per-repo Buildkite release pipelines (read-only)

maria: Why: inconsistent gating logic and flaky machine provisioning in Buildkite have caused several manual rollbacks. Centralized bot gives us consistent pre-release checks, artifact signing, and a single audit trail.

aj: Nice. What does the gating look like? Can we still do per-service custom steps?

maria: Yes — releases-bot runs a canonical job that kicks off per-repo plugin hooks. You supply a small releases.yaml in your repo to declare service-specific steps. Default safety checks are enforced org-wide.

taylor: Example workflow for GitHub Actions?

maria: Paste of minimal example:

```
name: release
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
jobs:
  gate:
    runs-on: ["self-hosted","gh-hosted-release"]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: call releases-bot
        run: |
          curl -X POST https://releases-bot.internal/api/trigger -H "Authorization: Bearer ${{ secrets.RELEASES_BOT_TOKEN }}" -d '{"repo":"$GITHUB_REPOSITORY","ref":"$GITHUB_REF"}'
```

maria: releases.yaml (optional) allows you to add: preflight scripts, canary routing, and post-deploy tags.

dena: Who gets the rollout notifications? We should tie into the current oncall rotation.

maria: By default the bot will post to #releases and ping the release-captain. We'll wire an integration to the oncall roster so @eng-oncall gets paged for failures during the Canary window.

jake: How will secrets be handled? We can't have every repo storing the bot token.

maria: Good catch. We'll provide a repo-scoped GitHub Actions OIDC workflow for ephemeral tokens. No long-lived secrets. Docs + migration script will inject the workflow and set up a repository secret referencing the ephemeral provider.

aj: Rollout schedule + opt-in process?

maria: Opt-in pilot (Wk1): add your repo to org/release-managed/PLAYER list in the spreadsheet I'll share. We'll run a paired migration with the Buildkite job still active.

maria: Wk2: enable gating by default for org/release-managed, owners will get a 72h window to opt-out. Wk3: Buildkite release pipelines toggled to read-only + archived logs moved to S3.

taylor: If something breaks during Wk2's org-wide enable, can we toggle back quickly?

maria: Yes — releases-bot has an org-scope rollback flag. Ops oncall can flip it and restore the Buildkite webhook until we fix the issue. We'll also keep the old agents in a frozen state for 14 days.

release-bot: [info] scheduled smoke tests will run nightly for pilot repos starting 2025-01-18 02:00 UTC.

dena: Any perf differences? Windows builds historically slower on GH Actions.

maria: We're using a dedicated hosted runner pool in GCP zonal instances tuned for Windows throughput. We ran benchmarks: median win build time down 12% across our sample, variance reduced. Full report linked in the migration doc -> https://internal.redwood.dev/releases/migration-plan (will post after this thread).

jake: Are there compliance/audit changes? We need signing for release artefacts.

maria: releases-bot signs artifacts using our KMS-backed key; audit logs are stored in retention=365d in the central audit index. SOC2 impact is minimal; security will file a short memo.

aj: Action items for pilot owners:
- Add repo to spreadsheet by EOD Wed
- Confirm a contact and SLA for rollout (whoops/rollback)
- Add minimal releases.yaml (template coming)

maria: I'll DM the pilot list and post the template in #devex in 1hr.

taylor: Thanks — I'll add payment-service to the pilot.

dena: Adding notifications: please post to #customers that transfers won't affect user-facing deployments.

maria: Will do. Final note: if you rely on custom Buildkite plugins that do heavyweight infra actions, let's chat — we may need a small adapter or keep that one job in Buildkite for now.

aj: :thumbsup:

taylor: :party-parrot:

maria: I'll follow up with the migration doc + spreadsheet. Expect a quick sync tomorrow 10:30am PT for pilot owners.

release-bot: [reminder] pilot kickoff meeting scheduled: 2025-01-15 17:30 UTC (calendar invite sent).
